mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 54 degrees.

The city has announced that Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 to allow for final asphalt and pavement work near the new Aldi site. Additionally, ongoing utility and road improvements continue to shift traffic lanes, so please stay alert and follow all posted detour signs.

Today, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow, the town is packed with activity including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the Farmer's Market downtown on September 30.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 5, Verona police received reports of a social media prank where cheese slices were placed on windshields across several streets in the city.
You can look forward to the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor today at Culver's, and the restaurant will open today at 10:00 AM.
